description.content: Returns a list of `policies`. By default, only `active` and `scheduled` policies are returned. Use the `status` query parameter to filter by other statuses. The `policies` are returned sorted by creation date, with the most recent `policy` appearing first.

query.description: Multiple values can be provided by separating them with a comma. Allowed values are: `scheduled`, `active`, `expired`, `cancelled`.
The page of results to return. Defaults to 1 if not provided.
The number of results to return per page. Defaults to 10 if not provided. Maximum value is 100.
